name: Gate 5A - Map one sanitized recovery result to review fields

nodes.name: Read Copied Sanitized Recovery Result
nodes.notes: Reads only the operator-copied sanitized Gate 4 recovery result staging file inside the n8n container. /home/node/.n8n-files is the n8n-approved file-access location. The operator copies the file in manually with docker compose cp; the workflow never contacts the AutoCount host and never modifies the file.

nodes.name: Validate Copied Sanitized Result Strictly
nodes.notes: Fail-closed: accepts exactly one nonblank JSON object matching the exact durable Gate 4 result contract with canonical Gate 4A identity shape, dry_run_only true, final_write_automation false, and a recomputed review state. Throws on anything else without echoing values.

nodes.name: Read One Approved Source Row
nodes.notes: Operator must select the Google credential and the real UAT spreadsheet in the n8n UI. The source tab is pre-set by name from the import copy (placeholder replaced before import); never re-select the tab inside the n8n UI, because a sheet-locator change makes the v4.7 editor reset dependent parameters. After binding, verify the Gate5AApprovedForMapping = YES filter is still present. Exactly one row may match. At typeVersion 4.7 the filter returns all matches by default so the downstream guard can require exactly one.

nodes.name: Verify Identity And Decide Mapping
nodes.notes: Rebuilds the canonical Gate 4A queue identity from the one approved source row (raw values in memory only, never output) and requires the sanitized result to match every shared safe identity field; a row number alone is never enough. Requires the controlled review columns to exist, requires a blank pre-mapping row or an exact prior application (already_applied), and refuses conflicts.

nodes.name: Apply Only Fresh Mapping
nodes.notes: True: fresh blank row, apply the controlled review/status update once. False: exact rerun (already_applied), skip the update entirely and emit evidence with zero writes.

nodes.name: Update Approved Review Fields Only
nodes.notes: Updates only the controlled review/status columns, locating the row by the stable non-PII operator marker Gate5AApprovedForMapping = YES (the verified v4.7 implementation uses the match column only to find the row and never rewrites it; virtual row_number stays identity evidence, never the physical update selector). reviewer_status is always UNREVIEWED; no create-approved value exists in this workflow. Cell format RAW so values are written as plain text. Bind only the Google credential and the spreadsheet here; the source tab is pre-set by name in the import copy and must never be changed in the n8n UI, because the v4.7 editor resets this mapping and the match column whenever the sheet selection changes. After binding, verify the match column, the nine mapped fields, and cell format RAW.

nodes.name: Re-Read Mapped Row For Verification
nodes.notes: Post-write read-back of the approved row using the same document binding and the same non-PII marker filter. returnFirstMatch is explicitly false so every match is returned and the strict verifier can require exactly one. Bind only the credential and spreadsheet; the source tab is pre-set by name and must never be changed in the n8n UI.

nodes.name: Verify Persisted Mapping Strictly
nodes.notes: Fail-closed persisted-state verification after a fresh update: exactly one approved row, full canonical Gate 4A identity rebuilt and re-matched against the sanitized result, and every controlled review/status cell exactly equal to the intended values. Any disagreement is a terminal sanitized error with no rollback, no repair, and no automatic retry; success evidence stays unreachable.

nodes.name: Emit Aggregate Evidence Only
nodes.notes: Emits the fixed aggregate-only Gate 5A evidence contract: statuses, counts, and hard-coded false write/activation flags. On the fresh-apply branch it requires the persisted-state verification output before reporting mapping success. No IDs, hashes, row numbers, member values, timestamps, or source values.

parameters.content:
### Gate 5A Boundary
Manual inactive single-result review mapping only. Do not activate. Do not add webhook, scheduler, wait, execute-command, HTTP, SSH, SQL, AC2, bridge, tunnel, member create/update/delete, or AutoCount write nodes. The AutoCount host receives no inbound connection: the operator copies the one sanitized recovery result file into /home/node/.n8n-files/ manually. Original Gate 4 and recovery artifacts stay byte-for-byte unchanged. The Sheet update matches on the stable non-PII marker Gate5AApprovedForMapping (never on row_number alone) and mapping success is reported only after post-write read-back verification of the persisted row. READY_FOR_CREATE_REVIEW stays review-only and reviewer_status stays UNREVIEWED; no state authorizes member creation.

Binding rule: replace REPLACE_WITH_SOURCE_TAB_NAME with the source tab title in the local import copy before importing; in n8n bind only the Google credential and the spreadsheet on the three Google Sheets nodes. Never re-pick the tab inside the n8n UI: a sheet-locator change makes the editor reset the update column mappings, the match column, and hidden options.
